verdict.rationale: The only exit-related evidence is a single line on the Executive Compensation page about representing founders in buyouts, IPOs and company sales, plus IP due diligence for acquisitions. No dedicated M&A or public-offering page for venture-backed companies appears, and the Emerging Growth/VC page lists only formation and financing work. Missing for 10: dedicated M&A practice page, IPO/capital-markets page, company-side exit deal experience or representative transactions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Representing founders and entrepreneurs in connection with early and late-stage financings, buyouts, IPOs, company sales and departures.
For clients interested in acquisition, financing, licensing or collaboration, we provide highly relevant and focused IP due diligence services.
